mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_customer (customer_id, tenant_id, name, email, phone, country_code, platform, store_id, total_orders, total_spent, last_order_at, tags, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{tenantId}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{countryCode}, #{platform}, #{storeId}, #{totalOrders}, #{totalSpent}, #{lastOrderAt}, #{tags}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT customer_id, tenant_id, name, email, phone, country_code, platform, store_id, total_orders, total_spent, last_order_at, tags, created_at, updated_at FROM crm_customer WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_service_ticket (ticket_id, tenant_id, customer_id, subject, description, assignee, status, resolution, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{tenantId}, #{customerId}, #{subject}, #{description}, #{assignee}, #{status}, #{resolution}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO crm_return_refund (return_id, tenant_id, order_id, seller_sku, customer_id, quantity, refund_amount, currency, reason, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{returnId}, #{tenantId}, #{orderId}, #{sellerSku}, #{customerId}, #{quantity}, #{refundAmount}, #{currency}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_return_refund SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE return_id = #{returnId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT return_id, tenant_id, order_id, seller_sku, customer_id, quantity, refund_amount, currency, reason, status, created_at, updated_at FROM crm_return_refund WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_review_analysis (analysis_id, tenant_id, seller_sku, marketplace_id, average_rating, total_reviews, positive_count, neutral_count, negative_count, sentiment_summary, analyzed_at) VALUES (#{analysisId}, #{tenantId}, #{sellerSku}, #{marketplaceId}, #{averageRating}, #{totalReviews}, #{positiveCount}, #{neutralCount}, #{negativeCount}, #{sentimentSummary}, #{analyzedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT analysis_id, tenant_id, seller_sku, marketplace_id, average_rating, total_reviews, positive_count, neutral_count, negative_count, sentiment_summary, analyzed_at FROM crm_review_analysis WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY analyzed_at DESC

SELECT analysis_id, tenant_id, seller_sku, marketplace_id, average_rating, total_reviews, positive_count, neutral_count, negative_count, sentiment_summary, analyzed_at FROM crm_review_analysis WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND seller_sku = #{sellerSku} ORDER BY analyzed_at DESC
